text: I think the main attraction is the break from routine. In a new country, even ordinary things like buying bread or catching a bus feel like small adventures. People also travel to see famous places they've read about, or to understand how others live. And for many young people, travelling alone is a kind of test — it shows them they can cope with unfamiliar situations.

tips.en: Buying bread and catching a bus is an unexpected, lively example.
tips.kk: Нан мен автобус — күтпеген, жанды мысал.
tips.ru: Хлеб и автобус — неожиданный, живой пример.
tips.example: even ordinary things like buying bread or catching a bus feel like small adventures

tips.en: Rest, learning and testing yourself develop the idea.
tips.kk: Демалыс, таным, өзін сынау — ой дамыған.
tips.ru: Отдых, познание, испытание себя — мысль развита.
tips.example: travelling alone is a kind of test

questions.followUp: Is it different for young and old people?
questions.question: Why do people like travelling to other countries?

text: The most visible one is overcrowding. Places like Venice or Barcelona have become so busy that local residents complain they can't live normally, and rents have gone up because so many flats are rented to tourists. There's also environmental damage, from litter on mountain trails to pollution from cruise ships. Ironically, too many visitors can destroy the very thing that attracted them in the first place.

tips.en: Venice and Barcelona support the general point.
tips.kk: Венеция мен Барселона жалпы тезисті дәлелдейді.
tips.ru: Венеция и Барселона подтверждают общий тезис.
tips.example: Places like Venice or Barcelona have become so busy

tips.en: Destroy the very thing that attracted them is a strong final idea.
tips.kk: Destroy the very thing that attracted them — күшті соңғы ой.
tips.ru: Destroy the very thing that attracted them — сильная последняя мысль.
tips.example: too many visitors can destroy the very thing that attracted them

questions.question: What are the negative effects of mass tourism?

text: I think a few basic phrases make a huge difference. Nobody expects a tourist to be fluent, but saying hello, please and thank you in the local language shows respect, and people usually respond much more warmly. When foreigners in Almaty say even 'rakhmet' instead of 'thank you', you can see locals smile. It's a small effort that changes the whole atmosphere of an interaction.

tips.en: Nobody expects fluency, so the answer stays reasonable.
tips.kk: Nobody expects … fluent — жауап орынды, шектен шықпайды.
tips.ru: Nobody expects … fluent — ответ разумный, без максимализма.
tips.example: Nobody expects a tourist to be fluent

tips.en: “Rakhmet” in Almaty is a vivid proof.

questions.question: Should tourists try to learn some of the local language?

text: Each has its advantages. A tour group is ideal if you have limited time or you're visiting a country where the language is completely unfamiliar, because everything is organised for you. Independent travel, on the other hand, gives you much more freedom and usually more genuine contact with local people. Personally, I prefer travelling independently, but I'd happily join a group for somewhere like remote mountains.

tips.en: Ideal if … sets conditions for each option.
tips.ru: Ideal if … — условие для каждого варианта.
tips.example: A tour group is ideal if you have limited time

tips.en: Prefer …, but I'd happily … is a flexible position.
tips.kk: Prefer …, but I'd happily … — икемді ұстаным.
tips.ru: Prefer …, but I'd happily … — гибкая позиция.
tips.example: but I'd happily join a group for somewhere like remote mountains

questions.question: Is it better to travel with a tour group or independently?

text: I suspect more people will travel, especially from countries where incomes are rising, but they might travel differently. Concerns about climate change could make people choose trains over short flights, as some Europeans already do. I also think technology will play a bigger role — virtual tours might let you explore a museum before you go. Still, I doubt anything will fully replace the experience of actually being somewhere.

tips.en: A prediction with a refinement: how many and how.
tips.ru: Прогноз с уточнением: сколько и как.

tips.en: I doubt anything will fully replace is confident but not absolute.
tips.kk: I doubt anything will fully replace — сенімді, бірақ кесімсіз қорытынды.
tips.ru: I doubt anything will fully replace — уверенный, но не категоричный вывод.
tips.example: I doubt anything will fully replace the experience of actually being somewhere
